cases.name: Jessica Tschirley Joyner
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Jessica was an amazing mother, sister and friend. She attended DeVry University, graduating and receiving many certificates, maintaining a 4.0 GPA and being on the dean’s list, all while being a mother to four beautiful children and spoiling her nieces. Jessica also graduated the (NEW) program in Brooklyn, N.Y., doing construction work.

Jessica had a huge heart and would give the shirt off her back. Her smile and laugh were beautiful and contagious no matter what mood you were in. Jessica loved telling jokes and pulling pranks on everybody. She was always a very strong woman and determined."
cases.narrative: He stabbed her in the temple and neck, severing her jugular vein and carotid artery. She caught her own murder on her cell phone. She escaped to an apartment across the hall. She collapsed and died about an hour later.

cases.name: Erin Bushek Somvilai
cases.narrative:
Her body had no obvious signs of trauma.

On 6/17/2018, her body was found. "An angler found Somvilai’s body June 17, partially floating, in a shallow Vernon County lake. Vernon County sheriff’s deputies contacted the La Crosse Police Department, which sent three investigators to the scene.

Somvilai’s body, weighted down with two concrete blocks tied to her torso with a chain and a yellow rope, was “significantly decomposed as well as significantly bloated,” Kudron testified. She wore “no undergarments or shoes” and was clothed only in a summer-type dress, he said."
